# Standalone strict ERK(19,46) certificate, part B of 2

Concatenate the JavaScript code block in part A then the code block in part B in a single file. Run under Node.js; only standard Node modules are used. The final variables AA46 and bb46 are outward intervals for every physical coefficient. Part A isolates the common 20-dimensional real algebraic zero and constructs the strict reflected initial bank; part B contains the complete losslessly compressed 135-row radical numerical input, constructs both actual blocks and all six physical replacements, and runs the audits. Vanishing identities are proved algebraically in the accompanying proof, not inferred from numerical intervals containing zero.

const qR=(()=>{const ax=(n,f)=>Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>f(i)),ab=n=>n<0n?-n:n,gc=(a,b)=>{a=ab(a);b=ab(b);while(b){[a,b]=[b,a%b]}return a},vv=(k=0n)=>[k,0n,0n,0n,0n,0n,0n,0n],zero={v:vv(),d:1n,nn:0},one={v:vv(1n),d:1n,nn:1},norm=(v,d)=>{if(d===0n)throw Error('field zero denominator');if(d<0n){d=-d;v=v.map(z=>-z)}let g=d,nn=0;for(let x of v)if(x){nn++;if(g!=1n)g=gc(g,x)}if(!nn)return zero;return {v:g==1n?v:v.map(z=>z/g),d:d/g,nn}},rat=(n,d=1n)=>norm(vv(BigInt(n)),BigInt(d)),add=(a,b)=>{if(!a.nn)return b;if(!b.nn)return a;let g=gc(a.d,b.d),i=b.d/g,j=a.d/g;return norm(a.v.map((x,k)=>i*x+j*b.v[k]),a.d*i)},mul=(a,b)=>{if(!a.nn||!b.nn)return zero;let v=vv();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){let x=a.v[i];if(!x)continue;for(let j=0;j<8;j++){let y=b.v[j];if(!y)continue;let g=i&j,h=i^j,p=x*y;if(g&1)p*=3n;if(g&2)p*=7n;if(g&4){v[h]+=147n*p;v[h^2]+=(h&2?294n:42n)*p}else v[h]+=p}}return norm(v,a.d*b.d)},neg=a=>a.nn?{v:a.v.map(t=>-t),d:a.d,nn:a.nn}:a,diff=(a,b)=>add(a,neg(b)),dt=(a,b)=>a.reduce((s,q,i)=>add(s,mul(q,b[i])),zero),scale=(a,b)=>a.map(q=>mul(q,b)),trans=M=>ax(M[0].length,j=>M.map(r=>r[j])),mv=(M,v)=>M.map(r=>dt(r,v)),mm=(M,N)=>M.map(r=>mv(trans(N),r)),ck=(x,n)=>{if(x.nn)throw Error('nonzero exact rational-field tuple '+n)},dec=l=>norm([63n*l[0],63n*l[1],63n*l[2],63n*l[3],3n*l[4],-2n*l[5]+7n*l[7],3n*l[6],l[5]-2n*l[7]],63n*l[8]),pow=(a,n)=>n?mul(a,pow(a,n-1)):one;

const supp=b.map((z,i)=>z.nn?i:-1).filter(j=>j>=0);if(supp.length!=6)throw Error('weights');let bank=[],tot=0,local=0;for(let n=1;n<=10;n++){let lay=[];function visit(remaining,j,v,fac){if(!remaining){let full=BigInt(n)*fac;ck(diff(dt(b,v),rat(1,full)),'all trees output p'+n);let pv=n<10?mv(A,v):[];if(n<=5)for(let i of supp){ck(diff(pv[i],mul(pow(c[i],n),rat(1,full))),'all supported local five');local++}if(n<10)lay.push({n,pv,fac:full});tot++;return}for(let k=j;k<bank.length&&bank[k].n<=remaining;k++){let t=bank[k];visit(remaining-t.n,k,v.map((z,i)=>mul(z,t.pv[i])),fac*t.fac)}}visit(n-1,0,ax(15,()=>one),1n);bank.push(...lay)}if(tot!=1205||local!=102)throw Error('exact donor tree census '+[tot,local]);console.log('CHARACTERISTIC-ZERO RADICAL INPUT: ALL',tot,'ordinary outputs and',local,'local-five in-row identities exactly zero, six actual weighted stages',supp.map(i=>i+1));return true})();
